_doc: The Go builder images a change request (rbd.change-request/v2 "base") may name: KEY -> image REF@sha256:<64 hex>. pr-check.sh admits only these keys; build.sh passes the value as --build-arg GO_IMAGE (the kit's Dockerfile: ARG GO_IMAGE, FROM ${GO_IMAGE}). Keys starting with _ are not bases. go1269 = today's builder (the Dockerfile's default). go127 = golang 1.27.3-bookworm, its index digest read from the Docker Hub tags API on 2026-10-30.
